episode_title: Meet Jacklyn Ether – FMS Writer Extraordinaire

real_qa.q: What services does Franchise Marketing Systems provide for franchise development?
real_qa.r: Franchise Marketing Systems handles everything including franchise disclosure documents, federal trademark filing, franchise information websites, business plans, press releases distributed through Restaurant News and EIN platforms, content writing for sales materials, in-store and trade show materials, eight-page sales brochures, evaluation forms, and discovery day agendas. The company breaks project fees into six to eight easy monthly installments.

real_qa.q: What writing and marketing roles does Jacqueline Ether perform at Franchise Marketing Systems?
real_qa.r: Jacqueline Ether writes press releases distributed through Restaurant News and EIN platforms for SEO and backlinks, develops content writing for franchise sales materials to identify and highlight each business's unique value proposition, coordinates in-store and trade show materials, collaborates with designer Noah Cunningham on eight-page sales brochures, creates evaluation forms for franchise buyers, and develops discovery day agendas for prospective franchise buyers to experience the business in person.
real_qa.requete: Jacqueline Ether Franchise Marketing Systems writing

real_qa.q: What sets Franchise Marketing Systems apart from other franchise consulting competitors?
real_qa.r: Franchise Marketing Systems stands apart through authentic team members personally rooting for every business owner's success, a broad spectrum of comprehensive services covering all franchise development needs from FDD to operations manual to trade show booths, willingness to answer all questions without making clients feel their concerns are trivial, and continued investment in helping clients succeed in the sales phase after franchise legalization. The company operates as a true one-stop shop with human understanding of client needs.

real_qa.q: How long has Jacqueline Ether worked with Franchise Marketing Systems?
real_qa.r: Jacqueline Ether has been with Franchise Marketing Systems for six years, during which she has worked on well over a hundred clients and developed deep expertise in translating her writing skills across many different types of franchise business models.

real_qa.q: What platforms does Franchise Marketing Systems use to distribute press releases for SEO and backlinks?
real_qa.r: Franchise Marketing Systems uses two platforms for press release distribution: Restaurant News and EIN. These platforms provide broad audience reach and boost SEO potential through quality backlinks for franchise clients.
real_qa.requete: Restaurant News EIN press release distribution
